name: Montford
description: Town where Farrel stirs up a frenzy; target of the Orc-Goblin army.

description_citations.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
description_citations.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Icatian army repels early Orc surprise attacks on border towns like Montford.
timeline.quote: The Icatian army easily repelled early surprise attacks by the Orcs on border towns like Montford.

citation.text: Icatian Infantry (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ailis Connaut is granted knighthood for her scouting and defense of Montford.
timeline.quote: Ailis Connaut acted with honor and bravery in the defense of the town of Montford

citation.text: Icatian Scout (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Unsuccessful in their early battle for Montford, the Orcs temper their bloodlust with cowardice.
timeline.quote: Unsuccessful in their early battle for Montford, the Orcs quickly tempered their bloodlust with cowardice.

citation.text: Orcish Veteran (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Oliver Farrel whips Montford into a frenzy against the Ebon Hand and appoints Sianna as his champion to slay Tymolin.
timeline.quote: Farrel then appoints Sianna to be his champion bestowing his mantle upon her.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Volume 1: Rumors of War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tevesh Szat vows to destroy the Sarpadian empires from within and unleashes the Orc-Goblin army on Montford through a Planar Gate.
timeline.quote: he vows to destroy the empires from within.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Volume 2: Nations Asunder". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tev opens a Planar Gate over Montford, letting invaders attack the outpost and Trokair.
timeline.quote: He opened a Planar Gate over Montford

citation.text: "Fall of the Sarpadian Empires", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oliver gives Sianna his mantle as champion and tries to kill Tymolin with his Aeolipile; Tev kills several members and disenchants the mantle.
timeline.quote: Tev responded with fury killing several members and disenchanting the mantle off of Sianna.

citation.text: "Oliver Farrel", section "Loss of the Mantle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
